steps.code:
access_token = login_result["access_token"]
page_index = 0
transactions = []
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction='sent',
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    print(f"Page {page_index}: {len(page)} transactions")
    if not page:
        break
    transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(transactions))

for t in transactions:
    print(t["transaction_id"], t["created_at"], t["sender"]["email"], "->", t["receiver"]["email"], "likes:", t["like_count"])
total_likes = sum(t["like_count"] for t in transactions)
print("Total likes:", total_likes)
